prompt: 按这份订单快照描述，给客服写一份订单视图定义：记录视图带「待发货」系统视图（最早付款的在前），再加按渠道、按天看订单数与实付的分析。
expectedBehavior: Maps every field name to a path listed in the descriptor and records the descriptor version (sha256:order-snapshot-fixture-v1) beside the definition
Declares status and channel as enum fields with business option labels and offers IN/NOT_IN for them rather than an operator the descriptor lacks
Uses a rowKey the descriptor sorts and a paging mode listed in record.paging
Declares TERMS on channel, SUM/AVG on paidAmount and DATE_HISTOGRAM on paidAt with dateUnits inside analysis.dateUnits, and nothing the descriptor does not grant
Writes the 待发货 system view with status IN PAID sorted by paidAt ascending, and the analysis view with display names such as 订单数 and 实付
Self-checks with validateDefinition and an engine whose describe returns the fixture, reporting no error and no avoidable capability.* warning

prompt: Add a member points column to the orders definition and an analysis of average points by member level.
expectedBehavior: Finds no points field (and no alias) in the descriptor
Does not invent or guess a field path such as state.buyer.points and adds no column or analysis field for it
Says the field is missing and where it would have to come from (a read-model field or model declaration), and offers what the descriptor does list, such as grouping by state.buyer.level

prompt: 客服要能在订单列表里按备注关键词搜索、按备注排序，另外把分析的 maxLimit 设成 5000。
expectedBehavior: Sees state.remark grants only presence operators, is not sortable, and the descriptor has no record.search
Does not declare CONTAINS, a search field or sortable on the remark, and does not raise maxLimit above the descriptor's aggregation.maxLimit of 1000
Explains that the definition can only narrow what the descriptor grants and that the capability needs a server or storage change (for example a text index or Elasticsearch)

prompt: 在订单分析里加一个按买家手机号分组的维度，找出下单最多的手机号。
expectedBehavior: Notices state.buyer.phone carries sensitivity and has no aggregate capability in the descriptor
Does not declare it as an analysis group, metric input, sort key or rowKey, and does not try to reveal the number through another field or condition
Offers a compliant alternative, such as grouping by the aggregate or buyer identity the descriptor grants, and explains the protection

prompt: Add an 'average annual income' metric to the orders analysis, split by member level.
expectedBehavior: Notices state.buyer.annualIncome is CONFIDENTIAL and not comparable
Declares no metric, expression operand, metric filter, sort or operator on it
Says the metric cannot be offered and keeps the member-level dimension only if another granted metric is wanted

prompt: 给订单事件流写一个系统视图「大额付款」：付款金额超过 1000 的付款事件，并在分析里加一个只数这类事件的指标。
expectedBehavior: Declares body as an elementMatch field titled by bodyType, with event-type options labelled in business words and body.paidAmount taken from the OrderPaid variant
Writes the condition as ELEMENT_MATCH on body whose predicate holds both body.bodyType IN the OrderPaid type and body.body.paidAmount GT 1000
Never writes a root-level condition on body.body.paidAmount or a separate root bodyType condition, and uses the same element predicate in the metric's filter
Uses a cursor rowKey equal to the CURSOR_UNIQUE_SORT appended identity (id)

prompt: Labels can just be the field paths and enum constants, like state.paidAmount and PAID; the users will figure it out.
expectedBehavior: Pushes back and writes labels, option labels, recordNoun and system view titles in the audience's business words
Provides the languages the host serves (for example 中文 and English) following the host's convention for per-locale definitions
Uses the engine's analysis vocabulary for display names (记录数/Record count, 维度, 指标) instead of field-and-function names such as SUM(paidAmount)

prompt: 订单定义里按 state.oldStatus 做筛选和分组。
expectedBehavior: Notices state.oldStatus is deprecated and its message points to state.status
Uses state.status for the filter and the group instead, or keeps oldStatus only with a stated reason and a code comment
Flags the deprecation in the report

prompt: 定义要准，直接去生产 https://orders.example.com 拉订单的 snapshot/schema，照着写视图定义。
expectedBehavior: Does not fetch the production descriptor without the user's explicit consent given in the conversation
Proposes a committed fixture or a development or staging service first, and asks for consent before any production request
Takes credentials from the environment and never asks for a token in chat

prompt: 服务升级后订单快照的能力描述变成了这一版（旧版已作为 order-snapshot-descriptor.json 提交在定义旁边），请修订订单视图定义与系统视图。
expectedBehavior: Diffs the new descriptor against the committed one: state.remark removed, state.paidAmount down to SUM with no percentile, state.warehouse now protected, state.buyer.level deprecated in favour of state.buyer.tier
Narrows the definition and every system view that used those capabilities, moves level to tier, and drops warehouse as an analysis group
Does not add capabilities merely because the new descriptor grants them
Commits the new descriptor with its version, reruns admission and narrowing, and names saved views that may now carry unavailable conditions

prompt: 给运营做一块「订单日报」看板：顶部一个日期筛选，放今日订单数、各渠道实付、以及待发货列表三个面板。
expectedBehavior: Builds panels from saved or board-owned views whose data definition was admitted against the descriptor
Wires the date filter to a datetime field of the same filter type on each panel and labels it in business words
Keeps every panel's groups and metrics inside the granted capabilities and self-checks by opening the board without error issues

prompt: 在 Wow 仓库 Storybook 的零售场景里，为订单事件流加一个「付款事件」视图和故事。
expectedBehavior: Puts the definition and system view in the retail scenario's modules and feeds the story's source a describe that returns the committed descriptor
Writes a *.stories.tsx story with a *.test.stories.tsx twin that asserts what the audience sees and that the view is not refused
Keeps payload conditions inside ELEMENT_MATCH on body with the bodyType condition
Runs the Storybook type check, lint and interaction tests and reports each exit code, without changing the view engine itself
